reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 5 recyclers trading the same material (24% of its feedstock)
Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 36% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 90% of months
In 100% of months, product sales fall far short of the claimed input
Sold products equal only 44% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
19% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
